subject: [PATCH v2] cgroup/cpuset: use mems_allowed_seq when checking a policy nodemask

reviews.author: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE)
reviews.summary: Identified that the patch has only performance implications and suggested removing Cc: stable. The reviewer's suggestion was accepted by the author.

reviews.author: Tejun Heo
reviews.summary: Applied the patch to cgroup/for-7.4-fixes without any further comments.

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch addresses a potential performance issue in the cgroup/cpuset subsystem by introducing a retry mechanism when checking a policy nodemask against the current task's mems_allowed. The problem arises from the fact that cpuset updates rebind the task's mempolicy and change mems_allowed in separate steps, which can cause a spurious numa placement miss under certain conditions. The patch uses the mems_allowed_seq to retry the intersection until it is stable.
